doc.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His father
summary: He knows little of his father, who worked around gas stations and left the family.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What about your – let’s talk about your father.
Oh, not too much about him, you know. Um, they sort of split after a time, and so not too much.
What kind of work did he do?
I don’t know, really. My father – I think we worked in Gas stations and stuff, I think he might have been a mechanic, something like that.
I don’t know too much about him. He was around for a while. They went their separate ways, you know. So that was that.
